steps.content: You're back in the Void of Yin. The moment your eyes open, your breath catches in your throat.
Pale cyan figures stretch in every direction, heads bowed in fervent prayer, as though awaiting an answer. The whole realm now resembles an immense ritual ground.
These things again... Unlike the creatures near the statues or the steles, they were born from Lichen herself.

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Three kneelings... nine prostrations... O soul... return...

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Three kneelings... nine prostrations... O soul... return...
The phantoms chant their prayers, mouths working the same sounds until the words fray into meaningless noise.
You hold your breath steady and weave cautiously among them, careful not to draw a single glance.
Solid footing is scarce, but now that you know what squirms beneath that sludge, you would rather leap from stone to stone than let your feet sink into it again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes?
Whispers, thinner than all other sounds, reach you. They sound as if they're drifting in from another world, one far more distant and yet somehow more real than this one.

steps.speaker: Weeping Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>I'm sorry... I'm so useless...

steps.speaker: Weeping Voice
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Wait for me... I'll go beg the masters again... I'll beg the gods again... I'll give them whatever they want...
Each footfall presses a damp, sodden sound from the ground, like stepping through a layer of tears. The voices sharpen, syllable by syllable.
Around you, the pale cyan figures multiply, lining both sides of the path ahead. You walk through their gathering, and a coldness crawls slowly up your spine.
<color=#fb9259>Offer no glance to the departed. Lend no ear to the abyss. Speak no question to the spirits.</color>
You drill the warning into your own mind while keeping your eyes locked on the path ahead.

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Three kneelings... nine prostrations... O soul... return...

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Three kneelings... nine prostrations... O soul... return...

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>O soul... return... wish... granted...!
Their limbs start to extend, drawn out longer and longer until they dangle limply into the dark sludge.
Then their torsos buckle and fold, contorting in ways that hurt to witness. Their mouths keep moving, gnawing at nothing.
Mindless as insects, they scuttle toward you at startling speed.

You've run out of safe footing. Your heel sinks onto something fleshy, a hand or a foot. The phantoms' hollow gazes snap to you instantly.

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2><b>You dare... stand in our way...!
